description:
In a multinational company's annual audit process, the audit coordinator initiates the audit process by sending a notification to the regional office.
The regional office prepares financial statements and gathers necessary documents.
Concurrently, the compliance team checks for any regulatory updates that might affect the audit.
Afterward, the regional office submits the documents to the central audit team.
The central audit team reviews the submission.
If discrepancies are found, they request clarifications from the regional office.
The regional office provides the necessary clarifications.
Once all documents are reviewed without issues, the audit team conducts a risk assessment.
The risk assessment includes evaluating financial risks, operational risks, and compliance risks, which can be done in any order but must all be completed.
If high risk is identified, then a detailed investigation is launched.
The investigation includes data analysis, interviews, and, in certain cases, site visits.
After all risks are addressed, the audit team compiles the audit report.
The report is reviewed by the audit director.
The audit director may approve the report or send it back for revisions.
If revisions are required, the audit team updates the report accordingly and resubmits it to be reviewed again by the audit director.
Once approved, the final report is distributed to the executive board and archived.
The entire audit process is then closed.

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ConductInterviews</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Audit" name="Annual audit initiated"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SendNotification" name="Send notification to regional office"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckRegulatoryUpdates" name="Check for regulatory updates"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_AnalyzeData" name="Analyze data"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConductSiteVisits" name="Conduct site visits"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SiteVisitMerge" name="Continue after site visit decision"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RiskOutcomeMerge" name="Continue after risk assessment"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CompileReport" name="Compile audit report"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReviewReport" name="Review audit report"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReportApproval" name="Report approved?" default="Flow_Approved"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RiskSplit_Compliance" sourceRef="Gateway_RiskSplit" targetRef="Task_EvaluateComplianceRisks"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Financial_RiskJoin" sourceRef="Task_EvaluateFinancialRisks" targetRef="Gateway_RiskJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Operational_RiskJoin" sourceRef="Task_EvaluateOperationalRisks" targetRef="Gateway_RiskJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Compliance_RiskJoin" sourceRef="Task_EvaluateComplianceRisks" targetRef="Gateway_RiskJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RiskJoin_HighRisk" sourceRef="Gateway_RiskJoin" targetRef="Gateway_HighRisk"/>

      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${highRiskIdentified}</bpmn:conditionExpression>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoHighRisk" sourceRef="Gateway_HighRisk" targetRef="Gateway_RiskOutcomeMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RiskOutcome_Compile" sourceRef="Gateway_RiskOutcomeMerge" targetRef="Task_CompileReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Compile_ReviewReport" sourceRef="Task_CompileReport" targetRef="Task_ReviewReport"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approved" sourceRef="Gateway_ReportApproval" targetRef="Task_ApproveReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approve_Distribute" sourceRef="Task_ApproveReport" targetRef="Task_DistributeReport"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Resubmit_ReviewReport" sourceRef="Task_ResubmitReport" targetRef="Task_ReviewReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Distribute_Archive" sourceRef="Task_DistributeReport" targetRef="Task_ArchiveReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Archive_End" sourceRef="Task_ArchiveReport" targetRef="End_AuditClosed"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
